# AuraScreen Complete LLM Documentation

> AuraScreen (Aura Screen / AuraScreen TV / aurascreen.me) is a web application providing free streaming access to movies, TV series, anime, Hindi cinema, and live TV channels.

## Site Structure & API Navigation

### Movie & TV Streaming
- Homepage: https://www.aurascreen.me/
- Movies Catalogue: https://www.aurascreen.me/movies
- TV Shows Catalogue: https://www.aurascreen.me/tv-shows
- Anime Catalogue: https://www.aurascreen.me/anime
- Hindi Movies: https://www.aurascreen.me/hindi-movies
- Live TV: https://www.aurascreen.me/live-tv
- Sports Coverage: https://www.aurascreen.me/sports
- Streaming Network Directory: https://www.aurascreen.me/providers
- Search Page: https://www.aurascreen.me/search?q={query}

### Detailed Route Templates
- Movie Details: `https://www.aurascreen.me/movie/{tmdb_id}`
- TV Show Details: `https://www.aurascreen.me/tv/{tmdb_id}`
- Watch Player: `https://www.aurascreen.me/watch/{slug}`
- Live Channel Watch: `https://www.aurascreen.me/live/{slug}`
- Provider Catalogue: `https://www.aurascreen.me/provider?watch_provider={provider_id}`
- Genre Category Browse: `https://www.aurascreen.me/browse/{category_slug}`

### Key Metadata & Technical Standards
- Standard Web Application Manifest: `https://www.aurascreen.me/manifest.json`
- XML Sitemap: `https://www.aurascreen.me/sitemap.xml`
- Search Robots Configuration: `https://www.aurascreen.me/robots.txt`
- Schema.org Types: WebSite, Organization, Movie, TVSeries, BreadcrumbList, ItemList (SiteNavigationElement)
